display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
锚点体系 sesno_version_anchor
• data 锚点：full(只读) / incremental_baseline / incremental
• model 锚点：model_gen（模型生成水位）
数据查询只解析 data anchor；
模型查询 / 导出只解析 model_gen anchor

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1742px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1010px; margin-left: 18px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: 关键不变式：① data anchor 与 model_gen anchor 分离——模型生成失败不回滚已提交数据，未消费的 model_gen_debt 保留供后续追平（自愈）；② Committed Watermark 是增量唯一合法起点；③ 项目 mutation lock + per-dbnum lease 串行化写入；④ versioned 为建库属性，切换须新目录重灌；⑤ 正式站点拒绝任意 generate/regen，只允许绑定既有数据锚点、写运行审计的受控 catch-up / repair。
